description: This file defines a set of classes representing various temporal expressions used for date and time range evaluations. It includes classes for date ranges, day/month/week ranges, frequency-based expressions, set operations (union, intersection, difference), and specialized expressions like null and substitution. These classes facilitate constructing and evaluating complex temporal logic trees within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions
classes.description: Container class for various types of temporal expression classes.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DateRange
classes.description: Represents a range of dates, encapsulating a DateRange object.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DayInMonth
classes.description: Represents a specific occurrence of a day of the week within a month.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DayOfMonthRange
classes.description: Represents a range of days in a month.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DayOfWeekRange
classes.description: Represents a range of days of the week.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Difference
classes.description: Represents the difference between two temporal expressions, effectively an exclusion.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Frequency
classes.description: Represents a repeating frequency of an event starting from a specified date.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.HourRange
classes.description: Represents a range of hours within a day.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.MonthRange
classes.description: Represents a range of months within a year.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Null
classes.description: Represents a null or empty temporal expression.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Substitution
classes.description: Provides a substituted expression in place of an excluded one.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Union
classes.description: Represents the union of multiple temporal expressions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the expression tree.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the expression.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Determines if a given Calendar date is within the expression.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first Calendar date matching the expression.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next Calendar date after the given date that matches the expression.

methods.name: getDateRange
methods.description: Returns the encapsulated DateRange object.

methods.name: getDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the day of week in DayInMonth.

methods.name: getOccurrence
methods.description: Returns the occurrence number in DayInMonth.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Returns the start day in DayOfMonthRange.

methods.name: getEndDay
methods.description: Returns the end day in DayOfMonthRange.

methods.name: getStartMonth
methods.description: Returns the start month in MonthRange.

methods.name: getEndMonth
methods.description: Returns the end month in MonthRange.

methods.name: getStartHour
methods.description: Returns the start hour in HourRange.

methods.name: getEndHour
methods.description: Returns the end hour in HourRange.

methods.name: getHourRangeAsSet
methods.description: Returns the hour range as a set of integers.

methods.name: containsExpression
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a specific subexpression (used internally).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the expression.

methods.name: getExpressionSet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of contained expressions (for Union, Intersection).

methods.name: getExcluded
methods.description: Returns the excluded expression in Difference or Substitution.

methods.name: getIncluded
methods.description: Returns the included expression in Difference or Substitution.

methods.name: getSubstitute
methods.description: Returns the substitute expression in Substitution.
